sentences.en: My name is Tom, and I've come here today to come clean about what I do for money.
sentences.zh: 我叫汤姆，今天我来这里是为了坦白我为钱所做的一切。

sentences.en: Basically, I use my mouth in strange ways in exchange for cash.
sentences.zh: 基本上，我用我的嘴以奇怪的方式换取现金。

sentences.en: (Laughter) I usually do this kind of thing in seedy downtown bars and on street corners, so this mightn't be the most appropriate setting, but I'd like to give you guys a bit of a demonstration
sentences.zh: （笑声）我通常在市中心破旧的酒吧和街角做这种事，所以这可能不是最合适的环境，但我想给你们做一下示范

sentences.en: about what I do. (Beatboxing)
sentences.zh: 关于我所做的事情。 （口技）

sentences.en: And now, for my next number, I'd like to return to the classics.
sentences.zh: 现在，对于我的下一个号码，我想回归经典。

sentences.en: (Applause) We're going to take it back, way back, back into time.
sentences.zh: （掌声）我们要把它带回来，很久以前，回到过去。

sentences.en: (Beatboxing: "Billie Jean") ♫ Billie Jean is not my lover ♫
sentences.zh: （口技：“Billie Jean”）♫ Billie Jean 不是我的爱人 ♫

sentences.en: ♫ She's just a girl who claims that I am the one ♫ But the kid is not my son ♫ (Applause) All right.
sentences.zh: ♫ 她只是一个自称是我的女孩 ♫ 但这孩子不是我的儿子 ♫ （鼓掌）好吧。

sentences.en: Wassup. Thank you very much, TEDx. If you guys haven't figured it out already, my name's Tom Thum, and I'm a beatboxer, which means all the sounds that you just heard
sentences.zh: 瓦萨普。非常感谢你，TEDx。如果你们还没有弄清楚，我的名字是 Tom Thum，我是一名 Beatboxer，这意味着你们刚刚听到的所有声音

sentences.en: were made entirely using just my voice, and the only thing was my voice.
sentences.zh: 完全是用我的声音制作的，唯一的就是我的声音。

sentences.en: And I can assure you there are absolutely no effects on this microphone whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 我可以向您保证，这款麦克风绝对不会受到任何影响。

sentences.en: And I'm very, very stoked — (Applause) You guys are just applauding for everything. It's great.
sentences.zh: 我非常非常激动——（掌声）你们只是为一切鼓掌。这很棒。

sentences.en: Look at this, Mom! I made it! I'm very, very stoked to be here today, representing my kinfolk and all those that haven't managed to make a career
sentences.zh: 看看这个，妈妈！我做到了！今天我非常非常激动地来到这里，代表我的亲人以及所有未能开创事业的人

sentences.en: out of an innate ability for inhuman noisemaking.
sentences.zh: 出于一种与生俱来的制造非人噪音的能力。

sentences.en: Because it is a bit of a niche market, and there's not much work going on, especially where I'm from.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个小众市场，而且没有太多工作要做，尤其是在我来自的地方。

sentences.en: You know, I'm from Brisbane, which is a great city to live in.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我来自布里斯班，这是一个非常适合居住的城市。

sentences.en: Yeah! All right! Most of Brisbane's here. That's good.
sentences.zh: 是啊！好的！布里斯班的大部分人都在这里。那挺好的。

sentences.en: (Laughter) You know, I'm from Brizzy, which is a great city to live in, but let's be honest -- it's not exactly the cultural hub of the Southern Hemisphere.
sentences.zh: （笑声）你知道，我来自布里兹，那是一座非常适合居住的城市，但说实话——它并不完全是南半球的文化中心。

sentences.en: So I do a lot of my work outside Brisbane and outside Australia, and so the pursuit of this crazy passion of mine has enabled me to see so many amazing places in the world.
sentences.zh: 因此，我在布里斯班和澳大利亚以外的地方做了很多工作，对这种疯狂热情的追求使我能够看到世界上许多令人惊叹的地方。

sentences.en: So I'd like to share with you, if I may, my experiences.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果可以的话，我想与大家分享我的经历。

sentences.en: So ladies and gentlemen, I would like to take you on a journey throughout the continents and throughout sound itself.
sentences.zh: 女士们先生们，我想带你们踏上穿越各大洲、穿越声音本身的旅程。

sentences.en: We start our journey in the central deserts.
sentences.zh: 我们从中部沙漠开始我们的旅程。

sentences.en: (Didgeridoo) (Airplane)
sentences.zh: （迪吉里杜管）（飞机）

sentences.en: India. (Beatboxing)
sentences.zh: 印度。 （口技）

sentences.en: (Sitar) China. (Guzheng)
sentences.zh: （西塔琴）中国。 （古筝）

sentences.en: (Beatboxing) Germany. (Beatboxing)
sentences.zh: 德国。 (拳击)

sentences.en: Party, party, yeah. (Laughter) And before we reach our final destination, ladies and gentlemen, I would like to share with you some technology
sentences.zh: 派对,派对,是的。 在我们到达最终目的地之前, 女士们先生们,我想与你们分享一些技术。

sentences.en: that I brought all the way from the thriving metropolis of Brisbane.
sentences.zh: 我从布里斯班繁荣的大都市 一路带回来的

sentences.en: These things in front of me here are called Kaoss Pads, and they allow me to do a whole lot of different things with my voice.
sentences.zh: 我面前的这些东西叫做考斯帕兹 他们允许我用我的声音 做很多不同的事情

sentences.en: For example, the one on the left here allows me to add a little bit of reverb to my sound, which gives me that -- (Trumpet) --
sentences.zh: 比如,左边那张,让我在声音上加一点回音, 这给了我一个——(Trumpet)——

sentences.en: flavor. (Laughter) And the other ones here, I can use them in unison to mimic the effect of a drum machine or something like that.
sentences.zh: 口味。 (笑声) 和这里的其他人, 我可以用他们一致 模仿 鼓机或类似的东西的效果。

sentences.en: I can sample in my own sounds and I can play it back just by hitting the pads here.
sentences.zh: 我可以用自己的声音做样本 并且只要打到垫子就可以放回去

sentences.en: (Noises)
sentences.zh: (噪音)

sentences.en: TEDx. (Music)
sentences.zh: TEDx。 (音乐)

sentences.en: (Applause) I got way too much time on my hands.
sentences.zh: (掌声) 我有太多的时间在我的手上。

sentences.en: And last but not least, the one on my right here allows me to loop my voice.
sentences.zh: 最后但并非最不重要的是,我右手边的那张 让我可以回荡我的声音

sentences.en: So with all that in mind, ladies and gentlemen, I would like to take you on a journey to a completely separate part of Earth as I transform the Sydney Opera House into a smoky downtown jazz bar.
sentences.zh: 女士们先生们,我想带你们去一个 完全分离的地球地区, 当我把悉尼歌剧院 变成一个烟熏的市中心爵士酒吧。

sentences.en: All right boys, take it away. (Music) Ladies and gentlemen, I'd like to introduce you
sentences.zh: 好了,孩子们,把它拿走 女士们先生们,我要向你们介绍

sentences.en: to a very special friend of mine, one of the greatest double bassists I know.
sentences.zh: 我的一个非常特别的朋友, 最伟大的双贝司手之一 我知道。

sentences.en: Mr. Smokey Jefferson, let's take it for a walk. Come on, baby.
sentences.zh: Smokey Jefferson先生 我们出去走走 来吧 宝贝

sentences.en: (Music) All right, ladies and gentlemen,
sentences.zh: 好了 女士们先生们

sentences.en: I'd like to introduce you to the star of the show, one of the greatest jazz legends of our time.
sentences.zh: 我想向大家介绍这个节目的明星 当代最伟大的爵士传奇之一

sentences.en: Music lovers and jazz lovers alike, please give a warm hand of applause for the one and only Mr. Peeping Tom. Take it away.
sentences.zh: 音乐爱好者 爵士乐爱好者 请掌声热烈掌声

sentences.en: (Music) (Applause) Thank you. Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: (掌声) 谢谢,非常感谢

sentences.en: (Applause)
sentences.zh: （掌声）
